Nina: FYI support escalated several trial orgs (CuraHealth pilot) — admins report invite button disabled. Tickets T-9910, T-9911.

Ethan: Marking support->CS handoff P1. Renewal touchpoint in ~5 weeks; adoption stalled.

Lina: Quick repro: POST /v1/invite returns 403 with reason="org_invite_restricted". Appears for migrated orgs pre-2026-02.

Tom: Can CS own outreach and schedule enablement? We should flip a migration flag as a hotfix. Eng estimates patch in ~4-6h.

Nina: Attaching ticket links: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/T-9910, https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/T-9911. Customer note: "Pilot blocked, need invites to proceed."

Lina: Proposed short plan: 1) Temp toggle for affected orgs now. 2) 30m remediation + onboarding walkthrough today. 3) 48h monitor + aim for 95% invites success. Owners: Lina (SE), Nina (support), Ethan (CS).

support-bot: Incident created INC-20260324-09. Teams: eng-platform, support, cs.

Tom: Toggle applied to cura-123 at 2026-03-24T15:05Z — invite tests 4/4 passed. Noted in tickets.

Nina: Customer joined enablement call; invited 8/8. Renewal risk downgraded to monitor. I'll close tickets after 24h observation.

Ethan: Thanks team. I'll add a blurb to weekly health sync and create a CS backlog item to track migrated-org invite UX.
